doc.title: Louis Armstrong and Herman Chittison Interview, 1960-05-04

title: Senator Green's Newport introduction and a San Francisco fan
summary: The host recalls Senator Green introducing Armstrong at Newport. Armstrong tells of an old New Orleans acquaintance in San Francisco who greeted him with a joke.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor
